27. DIP — Dependency Inversion
Principle

SIMPLE ENGLISH
High-level policy should not depend directly on low-level details; both depend on
abstractions that reflect policy needs.
සිංහJලෙන් Business logic එක database implementation එකට Jකළින්ම බුJඳන්න ඕන නුහු. Repository
interface එකට depend වුණාම Jවනස් implementation එකක් භාවිත කරන්න පුළුවන්.
OrderService can use SQL storage in production and an in-memory fake in tests.

SqlRepository · OrderService OrderRepository · InMemoryRepository · Implementations depend on the abstraction · Read the diagram: The client and concrete implementations depend on the shared abstraction. · Client එක සහ implementations Jපාදු abstraction එකට සම්බන්ධයි.

Q: Why does DIP help testing?
A: A test can supply a fake implementing the same contract without starting a database.
